_comment: WJD stem mirror, validation split (experiments/03-wjd-jazz-stems/03-dataset-and-wiring.md). Items are WHOLE TRACKS, one per target stem; the prompt is the stem's instrument name(s) from meta/<Track>.json and the condition is the drum stem's causal RMS envelope at the latent rate (1 channel, stable_audio_3/data/features.py), written into the controls sidecar by --features. Since 2026-10-02 the sidecar also carries the two 2-ch causal TRIA controls of experiment 3.4 (drums_tria_fixed, drums_tria_ema; dataset constants in configs/dataset_configs/features/wjd_drums_tria_stats.json), and, since 2026-10-03, the drum stem's 256-ch VAE latent (drums_audio, first in the sidecar). Two things decide what lands in the sidecar: (a) 'controls'/'features' here (or the --controls/--features flags, which win over this file; sbatch/03_3_preencode_wjd.sbatch always passes them, derived from WJD_CONTROL_MODE, default audio,rms,tria_fixed,tria_ema) say which keys the script WRITES: 'controls' are waveforms the module returns under __audio__ and the script VAE-encodes (256 ch), 'features' are frame-rate tensors under __features__ written as-is; (b) custom_md_wjd.py's WJD_CONTROL_MODE (same default) says which keys the module COMPUTES. A key listed here that the module does not return is an error, so keep the two in step. Only drums_audio, drums_rms, drums_tria_fixed and drums_tria_ema exist as keys; the drum latent is an audio control, never a feature, and it is renamed 'streamgen_latent' only on the training side (preencoded/*_chunked_preencoded.json), by position. Four dataset entries, so the output lands in <output_path>/{bass,other,piano,guitar}/ with independent id sequences; the pre-encoded config lists all four paths. Pass --sample_size on the CLI, never here (see the Slakh configs for why). Tracks are 131-901 s, median 310 s: encode whole tracks with --sample_size 16760832 --batch_size 1 and no --pad (380 s cap; the 12 longer tracks lose their tail) and crop at train time with latent_crop_length + random_crop. Dropping 'audio' (both here and in WJD_CONTROL_MODE) gives the earlier feature-only 5-ch sidecar; then the preencoded config must list only the three feature keys. No augmentation: --features and --augment_variants > 1 are mutually exclusive. The silence gates apply to the target only; the drums are gated by the module (RMS floor over the valid window).
